plugin.name: Skyrim SE 1.5.97 or AE 1.6.1170
plugin.description: For Skyrim Special Edition 1.5.97 and Anniversary Edition 1.6.1170. Built on CommonLibSSE-NG 3.7.0, which reads Address Library formats 1 and 2.

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.99 / 1.7.104 (current Steam version)
plugin.description: For Skyrim 1.7.99 and 1.7.104. Needs SKSE 2.3.x and Address Library All-in-One v13 or newer. Built on CommonLibSSE-NG 7.2.0; this DLL is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later (licence texts install with it).

plugin.name: Shorter (recommended)
plugin.description: Recommended. Step dodges cover a realistic distance: forward about 287 units (70%), back 180 (60%), to the side about 201 (80%), the diagonals by the same mix. The standard roll is shorter too (70%); the long roll keeps its full length. Run Nemesis or Pandora after installing.

plugin.name: Normal
plugin.description: Step dodges travel their full distance: forward about 409 units, back 300, to the side about 251. The standard roll goes about 409 in every direction.

group.name: Bow Rapid Combo V3 (Archer Combat Overhaul)

plugin.name: Bow Rapid Combo V3 keeps its bow dodges
plugin.description: With a bow drawn, Bow Rapid Combo V3's own back, left and right dodges (its flips) play, and Simple Dodge's bow step plays forward and on the diagonals. Pick this if you do not use Bow Rapid Combo V3, or want its flips. Installs nothing.

plugin.name: Use Simple Dodge's bow steps over Bow Rapid Combo V3
plugin.description: With a bow drawn, every dodge direction plays Simple Dodge's grounded bow step instead of Bow Rapid Combo V3's flips. Its bow attacks and other animations are not touched. Installs an Open Animation Replacer user.json that raises Simple Dodge's Bow set to priority 9901700.
